title: How should cooling boxes be scheduled when two heating furnaces share one charging machine?
summary: Suneng's 2020 heat-treatment equipment proposal lists two gas-fired heating furnaces, two enclosed cooling boxes and one shared loading/unloading fork truck. Those quantities do not establish continuous output. Put each batch's heating, transfer, cooling-box occupancy and unloading on one schedule to check whether the shared truck and cooling stations can keep pace.
